label: The internet
advice: Connect this computer to the internet (check the cable, Wi-Fi, VPN or proxy). Scoring, reports and runs on files already on disk keep working offline.

label: Name lookup (DNS)
advice: Name lookup is the usual culprit when the connection itself is fine: restart the network layer, turn a VPN off or on, or set a DNS server such as 1.1.1.1.

label: GitHub
advice: GitHub may be blocked by a firewall or down for a moment; check https://www.githubstatus.com and retry. A release archive downloaded by hand can be installed with install_latest.sh --archive.

label: GitLab
advice: GitLab hosts the gplas2 and plasmidEC source repositories; retry later, or check a proxy or VPN.

label: NCBI E-utilities
used_by: plasbench validate-cohort --online;plasbench discover-cohort;plasbench discover-design-cohort;plasbench resolve-contributed-cohort;plasbench build-publication-cohorts;plasbench collect-truth-provenance;plasbench prepare-contribution;plasbench curate-cohort;plasbench analysis discover-plasmid-free;python/validate_cohort.py;python/discover_ncbi_cohort.py;python/discover_design_cohort.py;python/discover_plasmid_free.py;python/resolve_contributed_cohort.py;python/collect_truth_provenance.py;python/build_publication_cohorts.py;python/build_plasmid_reference_set.py;python/curate_cohort.py;python/prepare_contribution.py
advice: NCBI can be slow or briefly down; retry in a few minutes. An NCBI API key (NCBI_API_KEY) raises the request allowance.

label: NCBI Datasets
advice: The NCBI Datasets service downloads reference assemblies. If it is down, retry later, or place the reference files in the data folder and use --local-inputs.

label: NCBI FTP
advice: NCBI's file server may be down; retry later.

label: NCBI SRA
advice: The SRA Toolkit fetches reads from NCBI. If it is down, set READ_SOURCE=ena to fetch the same runs from ENA, or place the reads in the data folder and use --local-inputs.

label: European Nucleotide Archive
advice: ENA (ebi.ac.uk) may be down or blocked; retry later, or use READ_SOURCE=sra to fetch from NCBI instead, or place the reads in the data folder and use --local-inputs.

label: Python Package Index (PyPI)
advice: PyPI is needed by pip; check a proxy or VPN, or retry later.

label: conda-forge and bioconda (conda.anaconda.org)
advice: Conda packages come from conda.anaconda.org; check a proxy or VPN, or retry later. Already installed tools keep working offline.

label: Zenodo
advice: Zenodo hosts several tool databases; retry later, or download the archive by hand on another computer and place it in the databases folder.

label: Figshare
advice: Figshare hosts the BMock12 control files; retry later. Files already downloaded and verified are reused.

label: Docker Hub
advice: Docker Hub serves the pinned micromamba image and the optional hello-world test image; check a proxy or VPN, or retry later.

label: PLSDB (University of Saarland)
advice: The PLSDB site may be down; retry later, or download the FASTA by hand and place it in the data folder.

label: winget package sources (Microsoft)
advice: winget downloads Docker Desktop from Microsoft's package index and Docker's servers; check a proxy or VPN, or retry later. You can also install Docker Desktop from docs.docker.com by hand.

label: Homebrew (formulae.brew.sh)
advice: Homebrew downloads Docker Desktop from its cask index and Docker's servers; check a proxy or VPN, or retry later.
